issue.title: test_workflow_step_has_no_kind_heading[parallel] fails: cheap header omits Step line
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_kind_headers.py::test_workflow_step_has_no_kind_heading[parallel]`

Failed twice on the same tree: once in an escalated full `just check` lane (34921 passed, 1 failed) and again in isolation with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_kind_headers.py::test_workflow_step_has_no_kind_heading -q --tb=short`. The `bash` and `python` parametrizations pass; only `[parallel]` fails.

The cheap header for a parallel workflow child is `Name: unassigned\nPatch: test_cl\nTimestamps: ...` and does not contain `Step: do\n`. `_append_project_fields` in `src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_display_header_metadata.py` emits the Step line only when `agent.step_type in {"bash", "python"}`. Parallel children fall through to the Patch/Name branch. The test parametrizes `["bash", "python", "parallel"]` and asserts `"Step: do\n"` for all three.

Either include `parallel` in that Step-line guard, or drop `parallel` from the parametrization if cheap parallel headers are intentionally patch/name-only. Unrelated to the Memory panel split that triggered the check.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed twice on the same tree: full-suite `just check` (34921 passed, 1 failed) and an isolated rerun of `test_workflow_step_has_no_kind_heading`. Only the `[parallel]` parametrization fails. `_append_project_fields` emits `Step: {name}` only for `step_type in {"bash", "python"}`, so a parallel workflow child's cheap header never contains `Step: do\n`.

evidence.note: Independent source confirmation while landing sase-r6 (proposing beads sase-r6.4). tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_kind_headers.py::test_workflow_step_has_no_kind_heading[parallel] still asserts 'Step: do\n' for step_type=parallel, but _append_project_fields in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_display_header_metadata.py emits the Step line only when agent.step_type in {'bash', 'python'}. Parallel children fall through to the Patch/Name branch, matching this bead's description. Confirmed on tree 194dbebfb; not caused by sase-r6 (paging/limit work).

Independent reproduction on master a3f600800 plus an unrelated PromptTextArea key-handling module split. tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_kind_headers.py::test_workflow_step_has_no_kind_heading[parallel] failed in just check (34920 passed, 2 failed) and again in isolation: cheap header is Name/Patch/Timestamps with no Step: do line. bash and python parametrizations pass. Matches this bead: _append_project_fields emits Step: only when step_type in {bash, python} after e85e1a7bc. Serial rerun of the node with the other failing check node still failed only [parallel]. Not caused by the prompt-key split. Applied the test-side alignment described here (assert Step: only for bash/python; assert no Step: for parallel) so just check can proceed on this tree.
